<!-- Title: Text + recipe title. -->
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from "vue";
import Prim from "../kit/ui/text/Text.vue";
import { cn } from "../kit/utils";
import { rc } from "./recipes";

defineOptions({ name: "Title", inheritAttrs: false });
const props = defineProps<{ "size"?: string | number; "weight"?: string | number; as?: string | number }>();
const attrs = useAttrs();
const rest = computed(() => {
  const { class: _class, ...r } = attrs;
  return r;
});
const cls = computed(() => cn(rc("title", { "size": props["size"], "weight": props["weight"] }), attrs.class as string | undefined));
const tagValue = computed(() => (props.as && Number(props.as) >= 1 && Number(props.as) <= 6 ? `h${props.as}` : "h2"));
</script>

<template>
  <Prim :tag="tagValue as never" :class="cls" v-bind="rest"><slot /></Prim>
</template>
